policy.completion_rule_11_8: zero open/in_progress product defects with severity blocker or critical

issues.title: Compact launch localization packs were not physically certified on the canonical branch
evidence: Current English multipart pack is contiguous part_000 through part_009 and totals 133572 Base64 characters; part_005 is 16000 bytes on the canonical branch.
Launch scope was explicitly narrowed to pt_BR and en; es_419 remains preserved as a deferred locale and is no longer a release gate.
Pack compiler and certifier now derive non-source targets from localization/manifest.json, preventing deferred locales from remaining accidental launch blockers.
issues.resolution: The stale English segment defect was repaired, and the product launch contract now explicitly requires Brazilian Portuguese plus English only. Spanish work is retained for a future localization expansion rather than treated as incomplete launch content.
issues.impact: No active blocker remains from compact-pack physical persistence for the current two-language launch. 11.6 still requires its separate linguistic, terminology, overflow, iconography and same-HEAD regression gates before promotion.
exit_criteria: English compact pack remains contiguous and totals the certified 133572-character payload.
localization_pack_certification.py targets only locales declared by localization/manifest.json and requires en=18804/18804 with pack=15334.
Deferred es_419 is not exposed as a launch locale until its own future certification is complete.

non_defect_release_dependencies.description: 38 final audio references and perceptual audiovisual QA remain production dependencies, not product defects.
Final large illustrations for domains/locations, characters/NPCs and enemies/bosses remain production dependencies.
